title: The ABC Sunshine Song
lyrics: A, B, C, come sing with me
D, E, F, as happy as can be
G, H, I, the sun shines bright
J, K, L, letters dance with delight

title: The Hopping Letters
lyrics: Hop goes M, hop goes N too
O and P are jumping, just like you
Q, R, S run around the park
T, U, V sing loud past dark

title: Alphabet Friends Circle
lyrics: W, X, Y hold hands and grin
Z closes the circle, let's spin, spin, spin
Our alphabet family is here to stay
